build_llava_llama_model: build a LLaVA model with Llama language model and CLIP vision tower for multimodal inference
encode_images_with_vision_tower: encode images through vision tower and multimodal projector to produce image features
pad_input_ids_for_images: pad input token IDs by replacing image tokens with image feature placeholders
load_llava_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights for LLaVA vision tower, projector, and language model
run_llava_forward_pass: run forward pass of LLaVA model with image and text inputs for extend or decode mode
